method: 2026-10-31 cross-repository W0X rewrite. One record per row of this spec: action, decisions, retirement reason, new children, rows requested in other specs, cross edits requested of other rows, and harness consumer notes. Rules: one row standard, production caller chain, served proof, both sides declared, knobs, ecosystem boundaries.

cross_edits_requested.change: Make each committed finance outbox fact claimable by queue finance.alert.<kind> through TaskQueueClaim.
List the finance alert queues as a production consumer.

decisions: Alerts use receipt-first delivery. An uncertain send is reported, never retried blind, which matches the confirmed-effect rule of R007.4.
The consumer reads the engine task queue pair; no new engine method is added.
Arbora has no scheduler, so the row adds a host loop with zone-aware wall-time keys instead of assuming one.
Schedules are operator configuration in finance.yml; the explanation job cites digests of the scan results it was given.

new_rows_requested.title: Prediction-market and order read tools for arbora

cross_edits_requested.change: Add the production consumer: arbora market.backtest_run (NEW:3).
Add the production consumer: arbora market.flip_confidence (NEW:3).

decisions: Paper submission uses the existing scope finance:propose-order. The scope finance:paper-trade does not exist in the engine scope catalog and is not added.
Arbora reaches venue data only through the fleet call path to emerald tools, per the connector-through-arbora rule.

cross_edits_requested.change: List arbora apps.admit as the production caller of the source-authority governed change.

decisions: Admission state is read from the engine on every step so a restart resumes from engine truth.
Parity compares counts plus a sampled key digest, with the sample size as a bounded arbora config value.

cross_edits_requested.change: Name arbora schema_context as the production caller and the Method that engine.schema_context sends.
Add the production consumer: arbora DCA plans (ARBORA-DATA-MARKET-R006).

decisions: The dead reference MERISTEM-CONTEXT-R006 is replaced by ARBORA-FLEET-R003 and SCION-GOVERNED-WRITEBACK-R001, which own the governed write-back lease.
